<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Moray Eel Mount](/Feats.aspx?ID=5288) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

</column>

---

You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild. You gain the [Bonded Animal](/Feats.aspx?ID=5127) skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites, to bond with a giant moray eel. When you [Command this Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400) while you are mounted on it to take a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action, you automatically succeed instead of needing to attempt a check.

**Special** If you have the [Elver Pet](/Feats.aspx?ID=5277) or [Growing Eel Friend](/Feats.aspx?ID=5282) ancestry feats, you can choose to have that pet become your bonded animal. You don’t need to spend 7 days of downtime to bond with the eel, and you automatically succeed at the [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) check. You can then [retrain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2634) those feats.
name: Moray Eel Mount
